hook: A first 3D map of seismic attenuation under El Hierro traces how magma rose before the 2011-2012 eruption.
hook_turn: how magma rose before the 2011-2012 eruption.
summary: Seismic waves lose energy differently in hot, partly molten rock. The team applied the coda normalization method to a large earthquake data set to build the first 3D attenuation model of El Hierro, then combined it with earlier velocity models. The picture supports magma climbing from depth through weak zones, though it is an interpretation of one eruption.
title: Seismic Attenuation Tomography of El Hierro: Insights Into Magmatic Processes in the Canary Islands
